- **One-Click macOS Authorization**: Auto"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"matically validates and imports signed macOS Anti Gravity client configurations, opening the standar"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"d browser OAuth flow without manual Client ID/Secret copying.
- **Dynamic Model Discovery**: Queries"},{"id":"p8s5","text":" the live `fetchAvailableModels` endpoint to surface reviewed Gemini, Claude, and GPT-OSS model vari"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"ants.
- **Independent Provider Route**: The plugin registers its own `google-antigravity` adapter, o"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"wns its catalog, and resolves OAuth. It reuses the exported `PiAiAdapter` only for Harness message a"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"nd stream conversion.
- **Built-in Login Page**: A package-owned Typert Remote provides login start,"},{"id":"p8s9","text":" status polling, and logout; the browser half registers a dedicated Anti Gravity settings page.
